quote: I used to wait for storms to pass before finding any peace within myself. But the rain kept falling day after weary day. People will leave your side when the weather turns cold. You learn to carry your own warmth through the darkest nights. At the end of the storm, you realize you were never meant to stay dry, only strong enough to keep walking.
